findings.summary: The spec's old-code-red/new-code-green dual-run echo is satisfied in substance but lives in the implementer's session log and commit message rather than the sealed verification_record: the dispatch contract forbids recording RED-phase runs there, so the old-base run (base 7f20b340 tree extracted via git archive, red-target tests run against it) is only inspectable in the attempt's launcher/session logs, not in a durable committed artifact.
